rule: check_consistency.py fails on any conflict it detects that is NOT listed here with status 'open'. Each entry listed here must still be detected (regression), until its status is set to 'resolved' together with the registry fix. Resolved entries keep their resolution for traceability.

conflicts.summary: Role of the θ operating range.
conflicts.resolution: Regime label. Notation Appendix v1.1 p3: θₜ is 'not clamped to the θ₀ band: it may leave the band transiently after δ_reset'. The band is [0.25, 0.85] AU on the excess-surprise scale; the draft [2, 8] AU does not occur in the published corpus. Lean: operatingRange_not_invariant (still holds for the new bounds) and decay_step_mem_Icc (the band is invariant under pure decay toward θ₀ in the band).
BF₁₀ ≥ 100. OSF pre-registration v1.1 Amendment 1 p69 declares it canonical for the summary table and the section; ≥10 occurs nowhere in the published corpus (the 'OSF v2' figure came from a draft).

Distinct. Bare λ is the leaky-integrator rate λ = 1 − exp(−dt/τ_S) ∈ (0, 1) (Math Spec p18). λ_θ does not occur in the published corpus: the threshold rate is γ_θ = 1/τ_θ and the learning rate is η_θ. lambda_theta retired; corpus pattern KC-LAMBDA-THETA guards against reintroduction.

Withdrawn. Notation Appendix p22: κ is in ATP/bit, uncalibrated, 'No canonical value is adopted'; sensitivity span 3 × 10³ to 10⁹ ATP/bit. The 1.7 × 10³ figure in APGI-Advances is a dimensionless overhead ratio under the deprecated meaning of κ (corpus pattern KC-KAPPA-OVERHEAD).

conflicts.summary: Parameters missing a value/range or unit.
conflicts.resolution: All filled from the pinned corpus (spec 0.2.0).

conflicts.summary: Δt ≤ τ_θ cannot be checked: neither value is registered.
conflicts.resolution: dt = 10 ms, τ_θ ∈ [10, 30] s, τ_S ∈ [0.2, 0.5] s: dt ≤ τ/10 holds for both, so euler_step_mem_Icc applies.

conflicts.summary: Used source without a sha256 pin.
conflicts.resolution: SRC-INNOV-GDOC retired (task 7, option B). EQ-CUSP-1 now rests on §7.7 of the v1.2 Mathematical Specification draft, pinned by sha256 as SRC-MATHSPEC-V12D until the v1.2 release replaces it with the published PDF.

conflicts.summary: The step rule dt ≤ τ_Π/10 could not be checked: the published corpus states only τ_Π > 0.
conflicts.note: Math Spec p6 and Notation Appendix p16 define τ_Π without a value or range, but both state dt ≤ min(τ_S, τ_θ, τ_Π)/10.
conflicts.resolution: Task 31: the v1.2 Math Spec draft (§2.6, SRC-MATHSPEC-V12D) fixes the design lower bound τ_Π ≥ 1 s. With dt = 10 ms and Δt_res = 1 ms both dt ≤ τ_Π/10 rules hold (0.01 ≤ 0.1). τ_Π itself stays uncalibrated; production uses 1000 s.

corpus_patterns.summary: Landauer at 310 K is 2.967×10⁻²¹ J. 2.871×10⁻²¹ J is the 300 K value: the corpus used room temperature, not body temperature.
κ is a molecule count per bit (ATP/bit), not mol ATP/bit.
κ is ATP/bit and uncalibrated (Notation Appendix §11). A dimensionless overhead relative to the Landauer floor is R_L, not κ.
Spectral radius is ρ_res, not κ. (Negations such as 'κ is never a spectral radius' are canonical and not flagged.)
ρ_crit is a criticality regime label (≈ 1); the reservoir spectral radius is ρ_res.
Bare α collides with sigmoid notation; use gain g, η_θ or γ_θ. (Decorated α⁺/α⁻, α_Π, α_EMA are corpus symbols.)
λ_θ is not a corpus symbol: use γ_θ = 1/τ_θ (mean reversion) or η_θ (allostatic learning rate).
c_θ is in AU (Math Spec p8, Notation Appendix p13); the Notation Appendix parameter table (Table 20, p37) lists it as n/a.
γ_sig = 1/τ_σ and τ_σ carries the units of S (AU), so γ_sig is 1/AU, not dimensionless.

Cross-level loop gain written without τ_Π (γ_ψ² < 1/(C_down·C_up), or 1 − C_down·C_up·γ_ψ²). With C_down, C_up in s⁻¹ that form is not dimensionless and differs from the stated (C_down·τ_Π)·(C_up·τ_Π)·γ_ψ² < 1 (Notation Appendix p19, Specifications) by τ_Π². Found in Paper 3 (Appendix B.5), whose γ_ψ ∈ [1, 3] bound rests on the τ_Π-free form. Bears on PD-LOOP-GAIN. Fixed in the v1.2 Paper 2 and Paper 3 drafts (task 38, 2026-11-25): the τ_Π form is canonical, and Paper 3 restates its coupling ranges as the dimensionless gains C_down·τ_Π and C_up·τ_Π, which keeps γ_ψ ∈ [1, 3]. The pattern stays active until the published PDFs are replaced.

SSOT v1.2 R6 sets no default sign for γ_NE (prior symmetric about zero; tonic and phasic NE separated). The v1.2 Math Spec draft still gives 'default > 0' (Table 1) and 'In the default parameterization (γ_NE > 0)' (§4.4). Found in the task-53 audit; fix in the v1.2 drafts.

Paper 3 sets the precision decay per level as τ_Π = τ_ℓ/10. With τ_ℓ = τ₀·k^ℓ (τ₀ = 50 ms, k ≈ 133) that gives 5 ms at ℓ = 0 and 0.66 s at ℓ = 1, below the v1.2 design bound τ_Π ≥ 1 s (Math Spec draft §2.6), and 5 ms breaks dt ≤ τ_Π/10 at dt₀ = 10 ms. Either scope the bound to the single-scale model or change Paper 3. Fixed in the v1.2 Paper 3 draft (task 39, 2026-11-25): τ_Π = max(1 s, τ_ℓ/10) at level ℓ, which keeps the Math Spec bound τ_Π ≥ 1 s for every level. The pattern stays active until the published PDFs are replaced.

production.tests: verification/python/test_production.py (strict xfail while a divergence is open)

divergences.where: config.py CONFIG['dt'] = 0.5
divergences.summary: Default step 0.5 s violates the spec's own rule dt ≤ min(τ)/10 (τ_S ≥ 0.2 s gives ≤ 0.02 s); reference step dt₀ is 10 ms.
divergences.resolution: config.py dt = 0.01 s (dt₀); configs/{dev,prod,staging}.toml likewise. dt ≤ min(τ_S, τ_θ, τ_Π)/10 now holds (0.01 ≤ 0.03).

divergences.where: config.py CONFIG['kappa'] = 0.15 with dt = 0.5
divergences.summary: Per-step decay exponent 0.15 at dt = 0.5 s implies τ_θ ≈ 3.3 s; the published range is 10–30 s.
divergences.resolution: config.py stores tau_theta = 20 s; the per-step exponent is computed as dt/τ_θ (config.decay_exponent), never stored. λ is rescaled through lam_from_tau_s and η_θ per step to 0.2 s⁻¹ × dt; the continuous threshold ODE now receives the rate η_θ/dt and τ_θ = 20 s (it fell back to 1000 s).

divergences.where: config.py 'kappa', core/threshold.py threshold_decay(kappa=…), 'kappa_meta'
divergences.summary: κ names the decay exponent (γ_θ·dt) and a cost gain; the Notation Appendix reserves bare κ for ATP/bit and deprecates κ_meta.
divergences.resolution: config 'kappa' removed (tau_theta instead); threshold_decay(decay_exponent=…); 'kappa_meta'/'kappa_units' renamed r_l/r_l_units (R_L, Notation Appendix §11) in config, schema and core.thermodynamics/core.threshold; allostatic_threshold_ode(kappa_meta=…) renamed c_theta. Old names stay as aliases emitting APGIDeprecationWarning for one release (core/deprecation.py). Remaining bare-κ uses are tracked as PD-KAPPA-RESIDUAL.

divergences.where: core/allostatic.py update_threshold_euler(theta_min=0.1)
divergences.summary: Default threshold floor 0.1; the Mathematical Specification default θ_floor is 0.

divergences.where: core/ignition.py sample_ignition_state; pipeline.py lines 1045, 1205
divergences.summary: Per-step Bernoulli(P) ignition sampling, which release v1.1 supersedes with the dt-invariant hazard 1 − exp(−r_max·Bₜ·dt).
divergences.resolution: core/ignition.py hazard_probability(B, dt, r_max) and sample_ignition_state(p, rng, dt=, r_max=); pipeline.py samples through the hazard at both call sites; CONFIG r_max = 100 s⁻¹ (= 1/dt₀, a placeholder until fitted). The per-step Bernoulli path remains only as a deprecated fallback.

divergences.where: config.py CONFIG['tau_s'] = 5.0; configs/*.toml
divergences.summary: Signal timescale τ_S = 5 s lay outside the published 200–500 ms (Notation Appendix p2, Dynamical Formulation p15). Found while rescaling for PD-DT.
divergences.resolution: tau_s = 0.3 s (worked value) in config.py and the three deployment profiles; lam = 1 − exp(−dt/τ_S) recomputed.

divergences.where: config.py CONFIG['theta_clip_min'] = 0.1; pipeline.py θ clip
divergences.summary: The pipeline clipped θ to [0.1, 20] AU, citing 'MathSpec §15'; Math Spec v1.1 states no such clip, and its floor default is θ_floor = 0 (§4.5).
divergences.resolution: Task 29 (floor to 0): config.py theta_clip_min = 0.0 and the pipeline.py fallback likewise. theta_clip_max = 20 AU stays as a numerical guard and is documented as not a spec quantity.

divergences.where: core/dynamics.py, core/preprocessing.py update_prediction(kappa=…) (learning rate); engine/somatic.py kappa (relaxation rate); engine/latent_state.py, estimation/*.py KAPPA (per-step decay); analysis/stability.py compute_jacobian_discrete(kappa=…); energy/bold_calibration.py *kappa_meta* names
divergences.summary: Bare κ and κ_meta still named non-ATP/bit quantities outside the PD-KAPPA-SYMBOL scope. energy/thermodynamics.py's kappa (ATP/bit) is the correct use and stays.
divergences.resolution: Task 30. update_prediction(eta_pred=…) in core.dynamics and core.preprocessing; SomaticThresholdAdapter(decay_exponent=…); models.reduced KAPPA → DECAY_EXPONENT (latent_state, estimation/*, model_registry follow); compute_jacobian_discrete(decay_exponent=…) and the 'decay_exponent_positive' result key; energy.bold_calibration calibrate_r_l_from_bold, estimate_bits_from_bold_energy(r_l=…), BOLDCalibrator.calibrated_r_l and r_l_* summary keys; energy.calibration_utils calibrate_for_realistic_r_l. Also in scope: CONFIG kappa_e/kappa_i → eta_pred_e/eta_pred_i (κ_e, κ_i are withdrawn, Notation Appendix; schema, validation, pipeline). Old names stay one release as APGIDeprecationWarning aliases, including retired result keys (core.deprecation.RenamedKeyDict). Found while renaming: the BOLD calibrator's ratio E/(N·E_min) is dimensionless R_L but was documented as J/bit, and example 05 fed it to the pipeline as joules_per_bit; both corrected.

divergences.where: config.py tau_pi = 1000, C_down = 0.1, C_up = 0.05, gamma_psi = 2 (hierarchy/coupling.py precision ODE, opt-in via use_hierarchical_precision_ode)
divergences.summary: The proposed subcritical cross-level loop gain (C_down·τ_Π)·(C_up·τ_Π)·γ_ψ² < 1 (Notation Appendix p19, p34) evaluates to 2 × 10⁴ at the production defaults if tau_pi is in seconds. The condition is labelled proposed and heuristic (Math Spec §2.6), and the production code does not state the unit of tau_pi. Decide the unit and either lower C_down, C_up or τ_Π, or record the condition as not binding.
divergences.note: Task 35 analysis (2026-11-24): tau_pi is in seconds in effect: core/config_schema.py validate_dt_stability takes min(tau_s, tau_theta, 1000.0) with tau_s in s, and the precision ODE is integrated with dt in s, so C_down and C_up act as s⁻¹. Production evaluates 0.1·1000 × 0.05·1000 × 4 = 2 × 10⁴. The corpus states the condition in two non-equivalent forms (KC-LOOPGAIN-NO-TAU): the τ_Π-free form in Paper 2 and Paper 3, γ_ψ² < 1/(C_down·C_up), gives 0.02 < 1 at the same defaults. Under the τ_Π form, the current couplings need τ_Π < 1/(γ_ψ·√(C_down·C_up)) ≈ 7.07 s, compatible with τ_Π ≥ 1 s. Task 38 (2026-11-25): the τ_Π form is canonical, and the v1.2 Paper 2 and Paper 3 drafts now use it. a9b2878 documents tau_pi in s and lets the step-rule validator use it. Still open: choose τ_Π in [1, 7) s at the current couplings, or lower C_down·C_up (Paper 3 v1.2 gives the dimensionless gains C_down·τ_Π ∈ [0.1, 0.5], C_up·τ_Π ∈ [0.05, 0.2]).

divergences.where: pipeline.py step() §3a-φ and §6: S_inst = instantaneous_signal_phi(Ψ(zᵉ), Ψ(zⁱ_eff), Πᵉ_eff, Πⁱ_eff); core/signal.py
divergences.summary: The default drive is the signed valence transform Π·Ψ(z) ('negative values suppress ignition'). The SSOT minimal core (EQ-DRIVE-1) is Π_rel·|z|_ex with |z|_ex = |z| − m₀ and Π_rel = Π_eff/Π̄; Ψ is an extension entering as |Ψ(z)|_ex. There is no excess correction and no relative gain anywhere in the package. Opposite-signed errors cancel (TC-09) and zero error gives zero drive instead of −m₀·ΣΠ_rel.

divergences.where: pipeline.py step() §3-§5: z = (ε − μ)/(σ + eps) with the precision EMA's μ, σ²; Π = 1/σ² from the EMA after ε(t) enters it
divergences.summary: Standardization and precision share one estimator, so Π·|z| scales as |ε − μ|/σ³ (EQ-STD-1 prohibits this; TC-17). z correctly excludes ε(t), but Π is computed from the variance after ε(t) is absorbed; SSOT §8 step 4 uses Σ(t) and updates the statistics at step 14.

divergences.where: pipeline.py step() §6: update_signal_ode (Euler–Maruyama, drift −S/τ_S + Π·Ψ, noise 0.01) unless use_canonical_discrete_mode; stabilize_signal_log(S, signal_log_nonlinearity=True)
divergences.summary: The default accumulator is a stochastic Euler–Maruyama step whose fixed point is τ_S·S_inst, not the exact leak S ← (1 − λ)S + λ·S_inst (EQ-LEAK-1). signal_log_nonlinearity=True then overwrites the state with log1p(max(0, S)) every step, which forbids S < 0 and compounds; the SSOT allows compression only as a read-out when Ψ is active.

divergences.where: pipeline.py step(): S accumulated (§6) before the ignition decision (§8); threshold_decay before ignition; apply_refractory_boost(δ·B) after the decay (§9)
divergences.summary: Execution order differs from SSOT §8 (EQ-PIPE-1): the decision must use the existing S(t), then the allostatic step with δ_reset·B(t), then the exact decay, then the reset, then the leak. Production decides on the already-accumulated S and adds δ after the decay, so one ignition raises θ by δ instead of δ·e^(−dt/τ_θ).

divergences.where: pipeline.py step() §7c-§7d: apply_ne_threshold_modulation, apply_serotonin_threshold_offset, circadian offset and hierarchical modulation applied to theta_next; self.theta = theta_next
divergences.summary: θ_eff terms are written back into the threshold state (TC-11; EQ-THEFF-1 read-out rule). Off by default, but once enabled the NE factor compounds every step (θ reaches the 20 AU guard) and the 5-HT offset accumulates toward β_5HT/(1 − e^(−dt/τ_θ)) ≈ 2000·β_5HT.

divergences.where: pipeline.py _enforce_ne_clamp returns early for γ_NE ≤ 0; config.py gamma_ne = 0.1
divergences.summary: The NE clamp is one-sided: a negative coupling is never clamped, while EQ-NE-1 and Lean CL-13 bound |γ_NE|·g_NE ≤ 0.5 for either sign. The default γ_NE = 0.1 fixes a sign; R6 sets none (prior symmetric about 0).

divergences.where: config.py theta_0 = theta_base = 0.55; stochastic_ignition = False; manifest() without the operating point
divergences.summary: Defaults differ from the SSOT: θ₀ = 0.55 AU (SSOT 0.35) and the default run is the hard-threshold limit, not the hazard. With ignite_tau = 0.5 the propensity floor is σ(−2·0.55) = 0.25, about 25 events/s at r_max = 100 s⁻¹, and the run manifest does not report γ_sig·θ₀, the floor or the stimulus-free rate (R1, TC-14).

divergences.where: config.py alpha_e = alpha_i = 0.05 at dt = 0.01 s
divergences.summary: EMA weights are fixed at 0.05, which at dt₀ = 10 ms is a 0.195 s horizon. EQ-EMA-2 derives α_EMA = 1 − exp(−dt/T_window) from the 5 s / 10 s windows: 0.0020 (extero) and 0.0010 (intero). Found in the task-53 audit.

divergences.where: config.py beta = 1.15 (dopaminergic bias β_DA on zⁱ)
divergences.summary: β_DA defaults to 1.15; the SSOT default is 0 (§4.2), so every default run carries a dopaminergic bias that also enters V(t). Found in the task-53 audit.

production_secondary.decision: Task 19: apgi_core counts as production code. It implements the spec's ignition, threshold, precision and reset equations independently of apgi-implementation and backs the Validation/Falsification protocols, so its defaults feed empirical claims.
production_secondary.tests: verification/python/test_production_validation.py (strict xfail while a divergence is open; skipped unless APGI_VALIDATION_PATH is set). CI job production-validation runs it at the pinned commit.
production_secondary.evidence: Divergences found by reading the source at de06453 (2026-11-24) and confirmed by running the module there (3 passed, 4 xfailed). Fixed in 628f5b1, merged to apgi-validation main as 811aee2 (2026-11-25), the pinned commit: 7 passed.

divergences.where: utils/apgi_settings.py APGISettings.theta0 = 0.03; apgi_core/full_model.py APGIParameters.theta_t0 = 3.0 (validated to [1, 10])
divergences.summary: Baseline thresholds outside the published θ₀ ∈ [0.25, 0.85] AU (Notation Appendix). apgi_core/model.py APGIConfig.theta0 = 0.5 is inside. The same E1 θ-scale defect the registry had before spec 0.2.
divergences.resolution: 628f5b1 (merged as 811aee2): APGIParameters.theta_t0 = 0.35 AU, validated to [0.25, 0.85]; APGISettings.theta0 = 0.35.

divergences.where: apgi_core/model.py enforce_stability θ ∈ [0.1, 5.0]; utils/apgi_settings.py theta_min = 0.01, theta_max = 5.0
divergences.summary: θ is clamped to a floor above θ_floor = 0 (Math Spec §4.5); the apgi-implementation counterpart was PD-CLIP.
divergences.resolution: 628f5b1 (merged as 811aee2): enforce_stability clamps θ to [0, 5] (5 AU a numerical guard); APGISettings.theta_min = 0.

divergences.where: apgi_core/full_model.py step() line 609; apgi_core/equations.py line 2823
divergences.summary: Per-step Bernoulli(P) ignition sampling, which release v1.1 supersedes with the dt-invariant hazard 1 − exp(−r_max·Bₜ·dt) (Math Spec Eq. 35).
divergences.resolution: 628f5b1 (merged as 811aee2): full_model.step and the equations.py engine draw ignition through 1 − exp(−r_max·Bₜ·dt), r_max = 100 s⁻¹ (placeholder, as in apgi-implementation).

divergences.where: apgi_core/full_model.py APGIParameters delta_t = 0.05 s, tau = 0.2 s
divergences.summary: Δt = 50 ms breaks the spec's dt ≤ τ_S/10 (= 20 ms at τ = 0.2 s). apgi_core/model.py (dt = 10 ms, τ_S = 0.35 s) and APGISettings (dt_ms = 10, τ_S = 0.3 s) comply.
divergences.resolution: 628f5b1 (merged as 811aee2): APGIParameters.delta_t = 0.01 s; __post_init__ warns when delta_t > tau/10.

divergences.where: apgi_core/model.py APGIModel.step: compute_signal = ½Πᵉ(zᵉ)² + ½Πⁱ(zⁱ)²; stats.update(ε) before stats.z(ε); deterministic ignite; synthetic interoceptive input
divergences.summary: model.py is an energy-form variant, not the SSOT core: S is recomputed each step from squared z with no accumulation (no EQ-LEAK-1), z is standardized against statistics that already contain ε(t) and share the precision estimator (EQ-STD-1), and ignition is the deterministic limit. Task 52 recommends labelling it a non-canonical variant (SSOT rank 7) rather than aligning it.

divergences.where: apgi_core/full_model.py APGIFullDynamicModel.signal_accumulation: S ← e^(−Δt/τ)·S + we·Πe·|εe| + wi·β·Πi·|εi|
divergences.summary: The full model uses the uncentered drive Π·|ε| (no excess m₀, EQ-DRIVE-1) and adds the drive per step without the λ weight, so its fixed point is S_inst/(1 − e^(−Δt/τ)) (≈ 20.5·S_inst at Δt = 10 ms, τ = 0.2 s) instead of S_inst (EQ-LEAK-1).

retired_patterns.reason: Built on a draft assumption that Bₜ was UI shorthand for θₜ. In the published corpus Bₜ is the canonical ignition propensity / event indicator (Math Spec §5, Eq. 26), so the pattern produced 91 false positives across 10 documents.
